data.notes: Search budget (20) used. Getz (predecessor nameplate of i20) and Atos (of i10) skipped as different nameplates. i20 Coupé (GB 3-door) and i20 Active not included (different body styles/model names). corrections.evidence: ADAC Autokatalog i10 1.1 Edition 20 (09/11-03/12, facelift): 'Kofferraumvolumen normal 225 l | Kofferraumvolumen dachhoch mit umgeklappter Rücksitzbank 910 l'; ADAC facelift Classic 01/11-10/13 (227049) also lists 225/910 l. Applies to both facelift variants (1.1 69 PS and 1.2 86 PS), set variant trunkFoldedL to 910 as well.

verification.notes: 13 WebSearch calls used. Confirmed via ADAC: i10 PA 3565/1595/1540/2380, 225/910; i10 PA Facelift 3585/1595 (ADAC 227051), 1540/2380, 225 l; i20 PB 3940/1710/1490/2525, 295/1060 (ADAC 217313, 224920), so i20 PB confidence can be raised; i20 PB Facelift values consistent; i20 GB 4035/1734/1474/2570, 326/1042 (ams test, angurten); i30cw FD 4475/1775/1565/2700, 415/1395 (ADAC incl. facelift 07/10-08/12 pages, same width/height/wheelbase/trunk); i30 Kombi GD 4485/2650/528/1642 (ADAC 233499-233504). i10 IA: width 1660, 252/1046 l and +5 mm wheelbase (2385) confirmed; length 3665 consistent with '+80 mm' vs facelift 3585; height 1500 not independently confirmed (one secondary source says 1490, press reports '50 mm lower' than 1540 = 1490 vs '40 mm lower' = 1500) - no clear contradiction, left unchanged. i30 Kombi GD width 1780/height 1495 not independently re-confirmed. Year ranges consistent with ADAC build windows (i10 facelift from 01/11, i30 Kombi GD from 08/12, i30cw facelift 07/10). No GTI/N/AWD/hybrid variants exist for these generations in Germany.
